A: **Demo Line vs Check Chairs.** Demo Line maximizes new skill per minute, picking varied fixes. Check Chairs splits twelve chairs into makers and checkers. Choose blended. Electrician picks three varied faults covering most skills; failed attempts brief next fix. Example: toaster, lamp, kettle teach heat, continuity, strain relief. Walk-in visitors fix while stranger checks, never own work. Test: following Saturday give unseen fan fault; blended regulars diagnose more than demo-only watchers, proving checking transfers skill beyond bringing.
B: **Lease Lead vs Clock Steps.** Lease Lead: one end holds crowd for timed grant, must yield at expiry; numbered handoffs reject stale loudness. Clock Steps: both play synchronized sets divided by barrier, checkpointing loudness. Choose Clock Steps with leases. Agree 20-minute steps; lively end plays soft, quiet end solos, then both pause at barrier. Example: east softens 7:00-7:20 while west leads; swap next step. Fencing number prevents both leading. Test: compare drift on swapped vs unswapped nights; quiet case fills without breaching cap, unlike optimistic both-try-loud.
C: **Replay Log vs Tiered Pager.** Replay Log files every drop as ordered event; nightly playlist is rebuildable and correctable by replay. Tiered Pager ranks waiting tapes by least-aired first. Choose Replay Log with pager. Day drops logged; snapshot posts current ledger. Three hours play least-aired; overflow waits tiered oldest-first. Example: tape 42 plays Tuesday; error logged, replay fixes Wednesday without rescan. Board lists played IDs daily so resident checks. Test: skip one voice a week; fault rate shows it prefetched next night, unlike fixed rotation.
D: **Keep List vs Link Web.** Keep List saves big pieces with origin tags: lane, story, donor crossing. Link Web saves small atomic keepsakes joined by explicit links. Choose Link Web. Each season meeting, daily crossers write one small card: moment, valid date, meeting date it was recorded; old cards are closed, never deleted. Example: rivet 114 links to 6am foghorn, marathon kiss, final bus. New bridge embeds linked rivets with QR to cards. Test: hide one card, ask newcomer to retell crossing; linked set retells fuller than list.
